heading: ## Scenario: composition surfaces an invalid candidate rather than shortening the list
reason: Closed by livespec-runtime-emu: compose_needs_attention no longer silently drops a candidate whose id fails validation. Validation is enforced at construction (AttentionItem.__post_init__ raises InvalidAttentionItemIdError), so composition refuses the call and the valid candidate is never returned alone. Mapped to the consumer tier (node-id prefix tests.consumer) per non-functional-requirements.md §"Test discipline" ("Scenario-tier coverage").
